map.两种方法结果相差大时检查输入是否准确: When the two methods differ greatly, check whether the inputs are accurate
map.两种结果可互相印证: The two results cross-validate each other
map.冠层形状支持圆形 / 方形 / 椭圆三种: Canopy shape supports circular / square / elliptical
map.冠层形状选错会高估或低估投影面积: Choosing the wrong canopy shape over- or under-estimates the projected area
map.几何法假设冠层规则，密植重叠率高时需填重叠率修正: The geometric method assumes a regular canopy, so a high overlap from dense planting needs an overlap correction
map.几何法和网格法哪个准？: Which is more accurate, the geometric method or the grid method?
map.几何法：填行距、株距、冠层直径、形状与重叠率: Geometric method: enter row spacing, plant spacing, canopy diameter, shape and overlap rate
map.几何法：输入行距、株距、平均冠层直径、冠层形状与重叠率: Geometric method: enter row spacing, plant spacing, average canopy diameter, canopy shape and overlap rate
map.密植时相邻冠层相交，目测相交面积占比填入，缺省可先填 0 看上限。: At high planting density adjacent canopies intersect; estimate and enter the intersecting area fraction, or enter 0 first to see the upper bound.
map.提供两种方法：几何法按行距、株距、冠层直径与形状估算单株投影覆盖；网格法按照片中: Two methods are provided. The geometric method estimates the projected crown coverage per plant from row spacing, plant spacing, crown diameter and shape; the grid method estimates actual coverage from the proportion of green cells in the image, for agricultural remote sensing, field trials and growth assessment.
map.点击「计算」得到覆盖率与对应面积: Click "Calculate" to get the coverage rate and the matching area
map.田间试验：评估种植密度是否合理: Field trial: assess whether the planting density is reasonable
map.种植密度计算器（株距×行距）: Planting density calculator (plant spacing x row spacing)
map.网格法基于实测照片更贴近实际，几何法适合规则种植的快速估算。: The grid method relies on measured photos and is closer to reality; the geometric method suits quick estimates for regular planting.
map.网格法拍照要正对地面、光照均匀，避免阴影误判: For the grid method, shoot straight down with even lighting to avoid shadow misreads
map.网格法：填总格数、绿色格数与拍摄面积: Grid method: enter the total cell count, green cell count and photographed area
map.网格法：输入总格数、绿色格数与拍摄面积估算覆盖度: Grid method: enter the total cell count, green cell count and photographed area to estimate coverage
map.覆盖度是比例，常用来算 LAI 等衍生指标: Coverage is a ratio, commonly used to derive indicators such as LAI
map.输出覆盖率百分比与估算面积: Output the coverage percentage and the estimated area
map.遥感校验：用地面实测覆盖度校正卫星反演: Remote sensing validation: correct satellite retrieval with ground-measured coverage
map.重叠率怎么估？: How is the overlap rate estimated?
map.长势监测：定期拍照用网格法跟踪覆盖变化: Growth monitoring: take periodic photos and track coverage change with the grid method
